gloss: roar of laughter; boisterous laughter; guffaw

definitions.gloss: roar of laughter; boisterous laughter; guffaw
definitions.explanation: roar of laughter; boisterous laughter; guffaw

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}に{哄笑|こうしょう}が{起|お}きた。
examples.english: A roar of laughter broke out in the venue.

examples.japanese: {観客|かんきゃく}は{哄笑|こうしょう}しながら{手|て}を{叩|たた}いた。
examples.english: The audience clapped while roaring with laughter.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}があまりにも{面白|おもしろ}くて、{教室|きょうしつ}{中|じゅう}が{哄笑|こうしょう}に{包|つつ}まれた。
examples.english: His story was so funny that the entire classroom was engulfed in laughter.

notes:
Describes loud, uninhibited laughter from a group or an individual. Has a literary or written register — in casual conversation, people would use {大笑|おおわら}い or {爆笑|ばくしょう} instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {哄笑|こうしょう}が{起|お}きる: a roar of laughter breaks out
- {哄笑|こうしょう}に{包|つつ}まれる: to be engulfed in laughter
- {哄笑|こうしょう}を{誘|さそ}う: to provoke laughter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {爆笑|ばくしょう}: explosive laughter — colloquial and very common; implies sudden, uncontrollable laughter
- {大笑|おおわら}い: big laugh — casual and friendly; the everyday way to say a hearty laugh
- {失笑|しっしょう}: involuntary laugh — laughing despite trying not to; often misused to mean scornful laughter
